design.cache: warm OS cache, no eviction; untimed per-case warmup
design.input: same existing first10000; no database reset or corpus generation
design.scope: nested wall spans and exact work counts; not CPU attribution or normal-release performance gate

interpretation: Diagnostic nested wall spans overlap and include instrumentation. Thread cycles describe only the calling benchmark thread, not the whole process. Do not add nested spans, call them CPU shares, or substitute instrumented results for normal-release p95 comparisons.
